attributes.name: Blessing of Yaezhing
attributes.powers:
Discard this card to add 1 die to any check.

Discard this card to encounter the top card of your location deck; if it is a non-villain, non-henchman monster, it is defeated.

After you play this card, if the top card of the blessings discard pile has Dexterity in its check to acquire, recharge this card instead of discarding it.
